verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned endpoints (`POST /v2/users/create`) and a maintained API changelog recording additive changes across the Team and Payments APIs, so the API is versioned and changes are tracked. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a versioning strategy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, an explicit versioning scheme and compatibility guarantees, and independent corroboration of version stability.
